quarterly_data.quarter: Sanofi press release: Media Update: UEG Week: Sanofi and Teva's duvakitug (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Duvakitug (anti-TL1A, with Teva) RELIEVE UCCD phase 2b long-term extension data at UEG Week 2026 (130 induction responders; 450 mg or 900 mg every four weeks; descriptive data): at week 44 in ulcerative colitis, clinical remission 47% and 58%, clinical response 82% and 87%, endoscopic improvement 59% and 63%; in Crohn's disease, endoscopic response 41% and 55%, clinical response 81% and 87%, clinical remission 81% and 84%; safety consistent with induction. Duvakitug is in the phase 3 SUNSCAPE-1/-2 (UC) and STARSCAPE-1/-2 (CD) studies; Sanofi and Teva have initiated the phase 2 AURALIGHT study in hidradenitis suppurativa and plan a phase 2 study in fibrostenotic Crohn's disease.
quarterly_data.figure: UC clinical remission 47% and 58% at week 44; CD clinical remission 81% and 84%
